name: The Keys
blurb: One road, too many bridges, and a deputy who has seen everything twice.

signs.text: SANDBAR: NOT ADVISED. Advice not taken.
BOAT RAMP: KEEP RIGHT. Trailers only. Nobody checks.
THE BOULEVARD: KEEP RIGHT. A little shorter. Mattress stores the whole way.
BRIDGE ICES BEFORE ROAD. It is 91 degrees.
NEXT GAS 40 MI. Next regret 2 mi.
IGUANAS HAVE RIGHT OF WAY. Legally unclear.
HURRICANE EVACUATION ROUTE. You are already late.
WELCOME TO THE CONCH REPUBLIC. No passport. Sunscreen mandatory.
UV INDEX TODAY: YES. No further data.
LAST CHANCE KEY LIME PIE. Next last chance 1 mi.
THIS SIGN LEAVES FIRST. In a hurricane: the next county.
FISHING CHARTERS DAILY. Fish not included.
CHUM KEY. Pop. 212. Pelicans not counted.
LIVE BAIT. Dead bait. Same price.
SHRIMP BOATS YIELD TO NOBODY. Always have.
LIME WEDGE KEY. Resort casual required.
SALVAGE KEY. Everything here was once somewhere else.
SCULPTURE GARDEN. Do not touch. Do not buy.
LAST RESORT KEY. The party was yesterday.
FOUND: ONE FLAMINGO. Has seen things.
BOARDWALK: KEEP LEFT. Planks rated for one tourist.
STAY ON THE BOARDWALK. The gators do. Mostly.
NO WAKE ZONE. Airboats exempt. They decided.
UNLISTED KEY. Not on any map. Including yours.
TIKI BAR: OPEN. Since before anyone found it.
SOUTHERNMOST POINT, PROBABLY. Photo line 40 min.
SUNSET CELEBRATION: DAILY. The sun has no comment.
YOUR SHIP LEAVES AT 4:30. It will not wait. It is a ship.

signs.text: SIDEWALK CAPACITY: 40. Current occupancy: all of them. City notice.
signs.note: Playtest 4 (P4-16). The city's notice, the joke is the institution and the tourist economy.

signs.text: NOISE ORDINANCE IN EFFECT. Effect pending. City notice.
signs.note: Playtest 4 (P4-16). The city's notice on a party street.

billboards.text: PARADISE FOR SALE. Some pieces still above water.
WATCH US WRECK LIVE. New episodes every crash.
INJURED ON A BRIDGE? You probably deserved it. The Law Office of Nobody.
SEE GATOR, OR GARY. Gator Gary's Airboat Tours.
THE SUN WON. Lobster Lotion, for the aftermath.
OPEN THROUGH EVERY STORM. Mostly. Landfall Liquors.
YOU WILL CATCH SOMETHING. Probably sun. Flat Calm Charters.
CAUGHT FRESH, CAUGHT ANGRY. Trap Line Lobster Co.
EVERY ROOM, A VIEW. Of another room. The Pastel Palms.
TIKI TIM'S UMBRELLA DRINKS. The umbrellas are decorative.
RAY HAS IT. If it sank. Big Ray's Marine Salvage.
HAIR OF THE DOG. Diner opens when we do.
SUNSET FEST: SUCCESS. Nobody remembers why.
LOUDER THAN THE GATORS. Prop Wash Airboat Tours. Earplugs $9.
FOUR HOURS, ONE STREET. Shore Excursion Desk.
KNOW WHAT YOU SEE. Island Tour Tram. Narrated, loudly.
SIX BARS, NO PLAN. Crawl Cartographers, est. last Tuesday.
RIDE THE LAST BLOCK. Fare to be discussed. Pedal Mercy Pedicabs.
billboards.note: Playtest 4 (P4-16). An invented pedicab company; the pedicab driver quotes a fare, then a different fare.

billboards.text: WAVE FROM THE BALCONY. Neighbors advise against it. Balcony Seats, $12.
billboards.note: Playtest 4 (P4-16). An invented balcony-by-the-hour business; the neighbors are the straight men.

billboards.text: KARAOKE FROM NOON. Mercy sold separately. The Key Change.

landingLines.text: TEN OUT OF TEN, SAYS A PELICAN
THE GATOR GIVES IT A SEVEN
AN IGUANA SAW THAT. IT TOLD NO ONE.
BEST THING CAUGHT ON THE CHARTER
STUCK THE LANDING. NOT THE SUNSCREEN.

meta.notes: M1 stub; the traffic lane owns this file. Since M2 traffic-3 the mix, pedestrian and animal weights reach the race (SimTrafficTypeDef.weight) and pick the kinds; a kind listed nowhere never spawns. The weights started as M1's per-category defaults (car 5, truck 2, and 1 each for pedestrians and animals, where a `pedestrians` roadside zone gets the odd stray animal). M3 traffic-4 (head start, 2026-10-01) adds a wasteland oddity to the mix (a runaway mobile home, 0.3, scaled in-race by the `traffic.oddities` slider) and the Keys animals (iguana, pelican, gator, and a gator on a lawn chair). The `parked-boat` type and its code are in, but it stays out of this mix until the rivals can steer round a stopped vehicle: in CI's 50-race batch, rivals stalled behind parked boats for up to 328 s. All six new types are drafts, so release builds leave them out until they are promoted. Key deer stay out: a protected species (M3.md traffic-4). The signs and billboards are the placeholder items from the content-pack doc's region stub (M2 traffic-3), for road-3's `billboard` slots; each id is stable, so the in-game veto can name it. Run W-R (interview, 2026-10-02, distinct keys) gives each key its own traffic in `traffic.areas`, keyed on the roads' district tags: shrimp trucks and boat trailers by the fishing village, rental scooters, convertibles and golf carts on the resort strip, wreckers and the Salvage Key shuttle bus on the junkyard key, party vans and coolers on wheels on the party key. Elsewhere (Conch Row, the bridges, the real roads) the region's mix holds. Run W-U (the pitch deck's #7) adds the Mangrove Boardwalk's signs and the Prop Wash airboat billboard by its channel, and Unlisted Key's two signs (the secret island off the sandbar, district key-secret). A board tagged site belongs to its one slot (the junction signs too): it never fills a pooled slot on another road.
